build_dataset_cub200: build a CUB200 dataset instance with train split, transforms, and bounding box annotations
build_dataset_imagenet: build an ImageNet dataset instance with val split, transforms, and bounding box annotations
build_transform_train: build a training transform pipeline with random resized crop, horizontal flip, and normalization
build_transform_eval: build an evaluation transform pipeline with center crop, resize, and normalization
build_dataset_from_args: build a dataset and label count from argparse args for cub or imagenet
